Class Athlete

java.lang.Object
Business.Entities.Athlete
public class Athlete extends Object
Represents an athlete participating in the Olympic Games. Stores personal information, delegation details and physical attributes.

  • Constructor Details

    • Athlete

      public Athlete(String id, PROFILE_TYPE profile, String name, Date birthDate, String delegationCode)
      Creates a new athlete with randomly generated attributes. Speed, endurance, strength, technique and precision each receive a value between 1 and 100, inclusive.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique athlete identifier
      profile - the athlete profile
      name - the athlete's name
      birthDate - the athlete's date of birth
      delegationCode - the code of the delegation the athlete belongs to
